articles.title: Giants doomed at Dodger Stadium by another disastrous dugout decision
articles.description: The Giants went to a lefty reliever Saturday who had allowed four homers in an inning the previous night in a tie game. It didn't go well.

articles.title: Giants’ Rafael Devers has been on a tear and he’s been headed for season-ending surgery all along
articles.description: The Giants placed Devers on the 60-day injured list and selected outfielder Scott Bandura from Triple-A Sacramento.

articles.title: Giants ace Logan Webb’s ‘weird season’ ends on IL with winter of soul-searching ahead
articles.description: San Francisco's ace fell short of throwing 200 innings for a fourth straight year while also posting his highest ERA in a full season.

articles.title: How the Giants who were dealt away at the trade deadline are doing
articles.description: The Giants have managed to be an entertaining club since the deadline. Not everyone they dealt has enjoyed the same outcome.

articles.title: Giants notes: Competition for Randy Rodriguez, a head wound for Bryce Eldridge
articles.description: After an entire year spent in Tommy John surgery timeout, Rodriguez will pitch in the Arizona Fall League as he works toward a comeback.

articles.title: Bryce Eldridge’s rookie season for the Giants puts him in rare, impressive company
articles.description: Eldridge is quietly putting up numbers in his age-21 season that put him in rarified company in the history of the game.
